headline: Litigation charge tips GAAP results into a loss
summary_short: Revenue rose 2.0% y/y to $1,081.5M and gross profit rose 6.3% to $735.4M, but a $271.6M net litigation-related charge swung net income to a $(77.9)M loss from $98.3M a year ago, with diluted EPS falling to $(0.40) from $0.49.
summary_long: GAAP operating and net income swung negative on a $271.6M net litigation charge (gross $324.1M accrued liability, $52.5M expected insurance recovery) settling substantially all outstanding claims from the 2023 CooperSurgical fertility-media recall. Excluding that charge, non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 26% to $1.21 and non-GAAP operating margin expanded 260bp to 27%, on 8% reported / 5% organic revenue growth across CooperVision and CooperSurgical. Free cash flow was $96.4M ($182.8M operating cash flow less $86.4M capex). FY2026 guidance: revenue $4.285-$4.321B, non-GAAP diluted EPS $4.58-$4.66; long-term FCF objective of over $2.2B (FY2026-2028) reaffirmed.

drivers.explanation: GAAP results were driven by a $271.6M net litigation charge to resolve substantially all outstanding CooperSurgical fertility-media recall claims; non-GAAP margins, EPS, and organic revenue growth all improved.
Growth was 5% organic across both CooperVision and CooperSurgical, with unfavorable FX (about -3pts) reducing 8% reported growth to 5% constant-currency.
Gross profit rose with revenue while gross margin held steady at 68%, as favorable FX offset higher costs including tariffs.
Operating margin fell to negative 3% from 18%, driven by SG&A from the $271.6M litigation charge; non-GAAP operating margin rose 260bp to 27% on execution and reorganization synergies.
EBIT moves with operating income; the swing reflects the same litigation charge, not underlying operations.
EBITDA decline reflects the litigation charge embedded in operating income; depreciation and amortization were not the driver.
Net loss is attributable to the $271.6M net litigation charge; non-GAAP net income rose to $237.4M, up from $193.5M a year ago.
GAAP diluted EPS fell on the litigation charge; non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 26% to $1.21 excluding that item.
